rationale: No prior race telemetry is available for iteration 0, so this is a baseline draft built from the contract. Speed: the course is about 4 to 5 m and must be covered in under 3 s, so average speed must be at least about 1.5 m/s. I set base_speed to 1.6 (PWM about 80 percent) to leave room for turns without saturating the wheels. Sensors: five sensors spaced 16 mm apart across x = -0.032 to +0.032 m, with size 0.012 m, so the 25 mm tape is always covered by at least one or two sensors. They sit 0.04 m ahead of the axle so the steering reacts before the wheels reach the bend. Weights are proportional to sensor x (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), so a positive signal (line to the left) steers left, matching the contract's sign convention. Control: kp = 3 gives a moderate correction (a 12 mm offset yields a turn of about 1.5, or about 525 PWM counts). ki = 0 avoids integral windup on bends. kd = 0.3 damps the oscillation expected from a high kp. line_loss = last_direction, so the robot keeps turning toward the side it last saw the line. Body and mass are mid-range (wheel_track 0.12 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m, mass 0.8 kg) for stable yaw. Expected result: completion on the development tracks at about 1.6 to 1.8 m/s, with a few line-loss events and rms_error under about 0.03 m. The main risk is oscillation at this speed, which the Evaluator and the next race should test.
